**UPDATE: Europe Union Clarifies Its "Final Warning" to Hawazan**

The Europe Union has clarified its position on the final warning it issued to Hawazan. It says it is a diplomatic ally of Hawazan and respects that alliance, and that the warning was not meant as disrespect or provocation.

The Europe Union also says it keeps its alliance with the Russian Union of Trade (RUOT) and wants to promote peace and stability among its allies.

It says the warning should not be read as a declaration of war or a threat of military action. It calls it a "firm diplomatic measure" meant to encourage understanding, accountability and a peaceful resolution.

"The European Union seeks peace, not conflict."

The Europe Union says it doesn't want to divide its allies and wants to help build peace and mutual understanding for everyone involved.

We'll update this story as more comes in.

**BREAKING: Greater Israeli Empire Joins the Fight Alongside Its Allies**

The Greater Israeli Empire has announced that it will stand and fight alongside its allies after what it calls a "wholly unprovoked and senseless declaration of war" on them. It describes these allies as the ones who came to its side when it was "unjustly and illegally attacked."

The empire says it will contribute "in every possible way," with military or economic support, and will "not cower in the face of such despicable arrogance and shameless aggression."

"We have not and will not forget those who came to our aid without us needing to ask. We will fight alongside our allies until the bitter or peaceful end."

The statement doesn't name the faction it's fighting. It follows Black Cat Central's declaration of war on the United Defence Council, the Europe Union, the Russian Union of Trade (RUOT) and the Global Occult Coalition (GOC).
